subject: Oceanography
title: Mid-Ocean Ridge System
description: Learn Mid-Ocean Ridge System in one minute.

hook.text: A 65,000-kilometer mountain chain winds through every ocean—entirely underwater.

buildup.text: Mid-ocean ridges rise 2–3 km above the surrounding seafloor at divergent plate boundaries.

discovery.text: A central rift valley runs along the ridge top—where magma erupts and new ocean floor is born.

twist.text: Spreading rates vary: the Atlantic ridge grows 2 cm/year; the East Pacific Rise grows 15 cm/year.

climax.text: Hydrothermal vents cluster along ridges—oases of life powered by Earth's internal heat.

punchline.text: Earth's longest mountain chain is hidden underwater.

quiz.question: What forms at the central rift of a mid-ocean ridge?
options: New ocean crust from erupting magma
